pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Lite: $9.99/month (or $7.99/month with annual billing); Plus: $29.99/month (or $23.99/month…); Unlimited: $94.99/month (or $75.99/month…)… The legacy Dream Machine plans (Lite, Plus, Unlimited) still exist and keep a free tier, while the newer Luma Agents tiers launched in March 2026… at $30, $90 and $300"

has_free_tier.note: Free tier applies to the legacy Dream Machine plans; the Luma Agents plans launched in March 2026 have no free option.

nl.tagline: Vloeiende AI-video en beelden, van prompt tot scène
nl.description: Luma's Dream Machine genereert video en afbeeldingen uit tekst en beeld, met aandacht voor vloeiende camerabewegingen. Sinds maart 2026 biedt Luma daarnaast 'Luma Agents'-abonnementen voor grotere creatieve workflows.
limitations: Twee naast elkaar bestaande abonnementsvormen (Dream Machine en Luma Agents)

en.tagline: Smooth AI video and images, from prompt to scene
en.description: Luma's Dream Machine generates video and images from text and images, with a focus on smooth camera motion. Since March 2026 Luma also offers 'Luma Agents' subscriptions for larger creative workflows.
notFor: People who want one simple pricing model
limitations: Two parallel subscription families (Dream Machine and Luma Agents)
